# Core Summary
An ultra-realistic AI influencer delivers a rapid, high-energy warning about the speed of AI adoption in a neon-lit podcast studio. The clip utilizes a multi-shot progression with 7 distinct segments featuring fast jump cuts and handheld camera energy to maintain a cinematic UGC vibe. Shot 1 opens with an extreme close-up hook, followed by Shot 2 [cut to] a side angle for mic adjustment, Shot 3 [cut to] a medium shot for gestures, Shot 4 [cut to] an over-the-shoulder tech view, Shot 5 [cut to] a close-up threat, Shot 6 [cut to] a front-facing opportunity pitch, and Shot 7 [cut to] a final engaging close-up.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:02]
Podcast studio interior, dark background illuminated by soft purple and blue LED strip lights. Bokeh effect on background neon signs. Shallow depth of field, focus plane set for extreme close-up.
**Audio Description:** Low hum of studio equipment, crisp vocal recording quality, no background music.

[shot2][00:02-00:04]
Same studio, side angle view. Professional black podcast microphone (Shure SM7B style) on a boom arm in foreground. Purple-blue ambient lighting reflects off metallic mic parts.
**Audio Description:** Continues. Subtle sound of metal adjusting.

[shot3][00:04-00:06]
Medium shot framing. Background remains blurred neon studio setting. Lighting consistent purple-blue glow, rim light on subject hair.
**Audio Description:** Continues. Subtle fabric rustle.

[shot4][00:06-00:08]
Over-the-shoulder perspective. Laptop screen glowing with blurred futuristic UI elements (blue/white light). Keyboard visible in lower frame.
**Audio Description:** Continues. Fast mechanical keyboard typing sounds.

[shot5][00:08-00:10]
Close-up framing. Background dark with neon bokeh. Lighting highlights facial texture.
**Audio Description:** Continues.

[shot6][00:10-00:13]
Front-facing medium shot. Studio background consistent. Lighting softens slightly for a more inviting tone.
**Audio Description:** Continues.

[shot7][00:13-00:15]
Close-up framing. Neon light flickers subtly in background.
**Audio Description:** Continues. Fades out slightly at end.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>
*Gender*: Female.
*Race/Ethnicity*: East Asian.
*Age*: Young adult (20s).
*Appearance features*: Hyper-realistic skin texture with visible pores and natural micro-imperfections, no plastic CGI look. Dark hair styled in a trendy smart casual look. Wearing a minimalist smart-casual top (neutral tone) and minimal jewelry (small earrings). Eyes are sharp, reflecting neon lights.
*Vocal Characteristics*: Clear, confident, modern accent. Pace is rapid and punchy during warnings, calming during the opportunity pitch. Timbre is warm but authoritative.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:02]
Extreme close-up on <ID_A>'s eyes and upper face. Neon purple-blue light reflects clearly in her irises. She leans slightly forward toward the lens, establishing immediate intimacy. Her lips move rapidly with urgent articulation.
<ID_A> (urgent, direct) says: [00:00-00:02]「AI is about to change your life… faster than you think.」

[shot2][00:02-00:04]
Jump cut to side angle. <ID_A>'s hand reaches into frame, gripping the black podcast microphone. She adjusts the mic position slightly closer to her mouth, a physical grounding action. Her expression is confident, head turned slightly toward the mic.
<ID_A> (confident, punchy) says: [00:02-00:04]「Not in 10 years… I'm talking months.」

[shot3][00:04-00:06]
Cut to medium shot. <ID_A> uses expressive hand gestures, palms open, emphasizing the scale of change. Her torso shifts slightly with the rhythm of her speech. The handheld camera feel adds subtle motion blur to the background.
<ID_A> (earnest, fast) says: [00:04-00:06]「Content, jobs, business — everything is shifting.」

[shot4][00:06-00:08]
Over-the-shoulder shot looking past <ID_A> at a laptop. Her fingers type rapidly on the keyboard, blurring slightly with speed. The screen emits a cool blue glow onto her hands. She does not speak directly to camera here, voice is heard as she works.
<ID_A> (warning tone) says: [00:06-00:08]「If you're not using AI already…」

[shot5][00:08-00:10]
Cut back to close-up on <ID_A>'s face. She leans into the mic, eyes narrowing slightly with a slight smirk. The lighting casts a dramatic shadow on one side of her face.
<ID_A> (sharp, direct) says: [00:08-00:10]「You're already behind.」

[shot6][00:10-00:13]
Front-facing shot. <ID_A> relaxes her posture, leaning back slightly. Her expression shifts from warning to calm excitement. Hands rest on the desk, palms visible.
<ID_A> (calm, powerful) says: [00:10-00:13]「But the opportunity? It's insane right now.」

[shot7][00:13-00:15]
Close-up. <ID_A> pauses briefly, then offers a soft, engaging smile. A neon light flickers in the background behind her. She holds eye contact as the clip ends.
<ID_A> (inviting, challenging) says: [00:13-00:15]「Question is… are you ready?」

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style is hyper-realistic with a cinematic UGC (User Generated Content) feel. Color palette is dominated by deep blacks, neon purples, and cool blues. Lighting is low-key but subject is well-lit with soft LED panels to ensure skin texture is visible (pores, natural shine). Shallow depth of field keeps the background in creamy bokeh. Image quality is high resolution with natural grain, avoiding the plastic look of typical AI video.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
The atmosphere is urgent yet empowering. It starts with a sense of impending disruption (tension) and resolves into excitement about potential (opportunity). The tone is authoritative but relatable, like a knowledgeable friend sharing a secret. The neon lighting creates a modern, tech-forward mood without feeling dystopian.
